zh-CN.title: 消息操作更简洁
items: “为所有人撤回”简化为“撤回”，“从我这里删除”简化为“删除”
点击删除后改用统一模态框确认，不再挤在消息操作条中
确认框会简要说明删除只影响自己的聊天记录

en.title: Simpler message actions
items: Recall for everyone is now Recall, and Delete for me is now Delete
Deleting now opens the standard confirmation dialog instead of expanding the action bar
The dialog briefly explains that deletion only affects your own chat history
